## How to use this booklet

This booklet is a map of knitting, one of the four Needle Arts on Curious Sparoows (with Crochet, Embroidery and Sewing). Every entry tells you, in one or two lines, what a tool, stitch, technique, tradition or project is. Every entry has an ID (such as KNT-05.3 for cables) that is also its address on the website.

- **Parts** are the big branches; **Sections** (KNT-01, KNT-02...) are the main topics.
- **Entries** carry a ☐ box: tick it when you have learned or made it.
- **Registers** give 24 projects with level, yarn, needles and time, and a history timeline.
- Start with **Part 0**, five two-minute questions.
